requirements.requirement: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000
requirements.evidence: Part 'hex-turbo-drawer-9000' does not exist in the catalog; searched text 'turbo', 'hex-turbo', '9000' and family drawer with zero matches. Built closest functional equivalent: one full base at 0,0,0 with adjacent base at 0,-1,0 providing the two-cell side condition required for a notch drawer, and fitted notch:0#-1,0#notch0 stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf (male-female hand notch drawer frame). No turbo variant available.

finish.summary: Built a base with a notch drawer (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) as the closest available analogue to the requested hex-turbo-drawer-9000, which does not exist in the catalog. House rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints).

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
